caption: The video showcases a wall-like assembly of clear plastic bins stacked in horizontal rows on a light wooden floor against a plain white wall with a brown baseboard. Each row holds balls of one rainbow color, ordered from gray and blue at the top down through cyan, green, yellow, orange, red, purple, and pink at the bottom, with a magenta spiral track lying on the floor at the lower left. The framing stays fixed throughout, so the bin structure, wall, floor, and spiral track do not move. Within the lower section, a red ball is already in transit and continues to advance slowly to the right. A red ball works its way rightward through the red row, appearing in progressively rightward columns and mid-roll poses, while the tilted purple balls and the pink balls below it show no clear displacement. The upper rows, from gray through yellow, look essentially unchanged. No new release or final drop is visible. The motion is ongoing transport along the red row.
relations: A red ball advances rightward through the red row, appearing in progressively rightward columns.
The purple and pink balls below, along with the upper rows, show no displacement.
The bin structure, wall, floor, and spiral track remain stationary during the transport.
